title: Here’s How to Shop New Blink Smart Home Security Cameras Online at Best Buy
summary: In 2026, Blink has a new collection of indoor and outdoor cameras with prices starting at $49.99.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

With the holidays and new year on the horizon, keeping your family and home safe and secure should be your top priority. Nowadays, home security is easier and more affordable than ever, thanks to Blink and Best Buy.

Shop Blink at Best BuY

In 2026, Blink Smart Security just launched a wide range of new wired and wireless smart home security cameras with prices starting at $49.99 at Best Buy.

Blink Wired Doorbell 2K+

$49.99

Buy Now at Best Buy

Priced at $49.99 at Best Buy, the Blink Wired Doorbell 2K+ , which comes in black and white, is a smart video doorbell with crisp head-to-toe views, two-way audio with noise cancellation for clear conversations and smart person detection settings, so you’ll always know who is at your front door. It works seamlessly with the Blink mobile app, so you can answer the door, even if you’re not at home.

Blink Mini Pan-Tilt 2K+

The Blink Mini Pan-Tilt 2K+ , which is priced at $49.99 at Best Buy, features 360-degree pans and 115-degree tilts for shorter blind spots when trying to keep an eye on your home. It has 2K video resolution for sharp picture clarity, while the indoor camera works with Amazon Alexa for a smart AI assistant ready for your commands. The smart home camera even has night vision built in, so it works just as well during the evening as it does during the daytime. And it comes in two colors, black and white.

Blink Mini 4K+

$79.99

At $79.99 at Best Buy, the Blink Mini 4K+ is a high-powered indoor smart home camera that features the best picture quality possible with High Dynamic Range (HDR) support and a 4K Ultra HD resolution for image clarity. It even has 10x zoom to really focus in on objects and subjects that may be in your home. It comes in two colors, black and white.

Blink Sync Module XR+

$99.99

The Blink Sync Module XR+ , which is priced at $99.99 at Best Buy, is a system hub that works with your home internet to support Blink smart home cameras. So if you have multiple Blink units around your home, this hub can take the Wi-Fi load without interrupting other devices you might have on your network, like laptops, smartphones, tablets, a smart TV and others. It also works as a Wi-Fi extender, so you can get coverage for the far edges of your property.

Blink Outdoor 2K+ Floodlight Camera

$129.99

Best Buy has the new Blink Outdoor 2K+ Floodlight Camera priced at $129.99. It’s a floodlight system that’s ideal for outdoor use, like on a garage or backyard patio, for additional security outside with 700 lumens of brightness and light. It’s even equipped with a sharp 2K camera, so you can always be watching.

Please note: All of these Blink products work with the Blink mobile app.

And with a My Best Buy Membership , you’ll get these items shipped for free. Otherwise, your cart has to be more than $35 to get free shipping. Additionally, you can opt for free in-store pickup at your local Best Buy.
